  export const texts = [{"value":"與 ","paraId":0,"tocIndex":0},{"value":"Ant ProComponents","paraId":0,"tocIndex":0},{"value":" 的 ","paraId":0,"tocIndex":0},{"value":"LoginFormPage","paraId":0,"tocIndex":0},{"value":" 類似, 但支持更多的自定義 CSS 樣式。","paraId":0,"tocIndex":0},{"value":"import {LoginPortal} from '@unikue/ant-buddy-pro';\n","paraId":1,"tocIndex":2},{"value":"import React from 'react';\nimport {LoginForm} from '@ant-design/pro-form';\nimport {LoginPortal, PageFooter} from '@unikue/ant-buddy-pro';\nimport {SelectLang} from '@umijs/max';\n\nexport default () => {\n    const loginForm = (\n        // 根據您的需要自行定製以下內容\n        // 通常是一個登錄表單\n        <LoginForm/>\n    );\n\n    return (\n        <LoginPortal\n            interactionHeader={(\n                // 根據您的需要自行定製以下內容\n                // 這裏使用一個多語言切換的下拉菜單\n                <div data-lang='true'>\n                    <SelectLang/>\n                </div>\n            )}\n            interactionContent={loginForm}\n            interactionFooter={(\n                // 根據您的需要自行定製以下內容\n                // 通常是一個頁腳\n                <PageFooter/>\n            )}\n        />\n    );\n}\n","paraId":2,"tocIndex":3}];
